messages:
maria: CI red on main after the runtime patch. Integration suite failing against Hosted API — specifically the auth + streaming tool-call e2e. Main failing test: test_hosted_toolcall_endtoend

devon: saw it. rerun started but still red. Landing logs below.

maria: minimal curl to the hosted endpoint returned 401:
```
$ curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_SERVICE_KEY" https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"token not found"}
```

kevin: my first thought: secret rotation. CI uses CI_SERVICE_KEY from vault. @lia any rotation events?

lia: yep, secrets-manager shows CI_SERVICE_KEY rotated at 2026-03-17T03:00:12Z. The CI runner image used to have vault-agent mount; PR #1498 bumped the ci-image and the mount path changed. If the agent container didn't mount, the runner won't refresh tokens.

maria: that PR landed on main last night. that would explain the 401. can we bisect the changeet range quick? would prefer revert-hotfix if true.

devon: I can run a local git bisect and reproduce the failing test in docker. Can someone attach the CI runner logs/artifacts? Also, setting HOSTED_API_MOCK=1 would force tests to run against mock and unblock merges temporarily.

ci-bot: @devon triggered: pipeline/2345 rerun (queued)

kevin: aside — I noticed a schema mismatch in the payload when I hit a dev instance: tests expect `tool_args` but hosted now returns `args`. Might be an earlier change in the toolcall contract. But 401 is the immediate blocker.

maria: proposed plan:
1) lia opens PR to revert ci-image bump (hotfix)
2) rerun full integration after revert
3) if still failing, bisect commit range and add a smoke test for token refresh

lia: putting up revert PR now -> #1506. link once ready.

devon: I'll watch pipeline/2345 and start a local bisect on the PR range. ping me if artifacts uploaded.

maria: thanks — tagging @eng-oncall for awareness :eyes: 

oncall-bot: Incident note created: hosted-api-integ-fails-2026-03-17. Assigned: eng-infra

lia: PR #1506 created, CI image reverted. testing in my fork passes unit + smoke. requesting review from kevin.

kevin: reviewing now, will approve if CI green. Also adding a follow-up to add token-refresh smoke test and update runbook.

maria: perfect. will update the release notes if we ship the revert. keep updates here.
